@@ halflings
Halflings have an unclear origin, although they arose about th same time as Men. Indeed, they are said to be related to Men. The are the smallest of the races, Halflings range between 2 and 4 fee in height, and tend to be fat or pudgy. They are sometimes calle “The Hairfoots” because of their large hairy feet.

@@ hysical_haracter
Build: They have large and hairy feet—to the point of bein furry. Males average 54 pounds, while females average 5 pounds. Coloring: Brown skin and hair. Neat and uniformly beardless Endurance: Halflings have a subtle ruggedness which is akin t that of Dwarves and Orcs. When pushed, they can travel lon distances over tough terrain. Height: Males average 3'5", females average 3'3". Lifespan: 90-110 years. They become adults at 30. Resistance: Their feet and hands are almost immune to heat an cold. Accordingly, they are almost always barefoot. +30 D and RR bonuses versus heat and cold attacks. Their innat simplicity and innocence gives them heightened resistance t magical attacks (this is reflected in their high racial RR mod fication). Special Abilities: Dexterous, they move nimbly and quietly Their long, strangely slender fingers allow them to craft fin handiwork and help explain their fine reputation as thieves (thi is reflected in their high racial Agility stat bonus).

@@ ulture
Clothing & Decoration: They wear linen or wool garb—shirts pants which fall to the upper ankle, and brightly colored vests They occasionally don hats, but rarely wear shoes or gloves.e y Fears & Inabilities: Halflings shy away from the bizarre o t unusual, but otherwise have normal dispositions. d Lifestyle: Generally, Halflings burrow and dig and reside in “holes.” They are capable craftsmen, but are not friends o complex machines or magic. Their vices are few: six heft meals a day, pipeweed smoking, and bright apparel. g Most Halflings enjoy the simple life of farmers, millers, an 1 craftsmen. Workshops and sheds dot their territories, uni formly low structures, for the halflings hate towers and rarel . build above the first story. o Marriage Pattern: Monogamous. They trace their lines throug g either the male or female. Religion: Halfling religion is without exception low-key and informal. It is actually a series of joyful celebrations centerin on the gifts of Nature. d O F

@@ ackground_ptions
Those Halflings who dare venture away from home are as sumed to be extraordinary, and therefore get five background options. Extra Languages: In addition to the tongues listed above: Hill speech (S4/W4), Wood-speech (S6/W6), Orcish (S2/W2), an Elvish (S8/W8). Extra Money: Gold pieces of High Mannish mint. Special Items: Spell adders and items that cast spells not avail able. Only items that perform a natural task in a superior wa (weapon, saddle, rope, lockpick, etc.) would be present in Halfling society. Talents: Re-roll all “spell-user” results.
